scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check_view.mjs && node scripts/check_forms.mjs && node scripts/check_clock.ts && node scripts/check_csv.ts && node scripts/check_summary.ts && node scripts/check_starters.mjs && node scripts/check_dashboard.mjs && node scripts/check_sw.mjs && node scripts/check_sprites.mjs && node --experimental-vm-modules scripts/check_startup.mjs && node scripts/check_image_versions.mjs
scripts.build:prod: env -u VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY vite build && node scripts/build_game_pages.ts && (grep -qE 'pk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}' dist/assets/*.js || (echo 'No live Clerk key in the build. Add .env.production (see the main checkout).' >&2; exit 1))
scripts.deploy: (test -z "$(git status --porcelain --ignored public)" || (echo 'Uncommitted files in public/ would be deployed. Commit or remove them first.' >&2; exit 1)) && convex deploy -y --cmd 'pnpm build:prod' && wrangler deploy
